notes: Speech corpora are acted emotion datasets, not depression or suicide-risk labels.
Corpus, device, language, and accent bias may remain even with speaker isolation.
TESS has only 2 speakers and SAVEE has only 4 speakers, so all corpora cannot meaningfully populate every split.
Leave-one-corpus-out evaluation should be considered during training-framework design.
70/15/15 is used as a global speaker-independent split, but speaker isolation is prioritized over exact proportions.
TESS has only 2 speakers and SAVEE has only 4 speakers, so per-corpus three-way balance is impossible.
Leave-one-corpus-out evaluation is recommended as an additional training-framework design.
source_split_policy: speaker-independent grouped split; corpus identity is reported and not used as a predictive feature

warnings: speaker-independent split is prioritized over perfect corpus balance
